title: Companions
summary: Nine named companions and how they join.
bodyHtml:
src/game/content/npcs.ts defines nine named companions: Mattie Voss, Juniper Cole, Thaddeus Moreau, Birdie Nkemelu, Brother Ambrose, Rue Delacroix, Orin Fell, Hollis Grey, Nell Ashby.

Each has a role, traits, a one-line backstory, a Look (build, height, age, skin, hair, clothing, palette, prop, marks, summary), join lines, and a complication scene. Looks are meant for portraits and video prompts.

  • Recruiting one makes them an ordinary party member (recruited, flag joined:<id>).
  • After afterDays, their complication fires once as a scene where they speak.
  • Some strangers recur, gated on met:<id> flags.
  • 17 companion scenes cover first meetings, complications and returns.

The starting roster (content/roster.ts) is separate: twelve people such as Ines Calloway, Dov Reyes, Sister Odalys and Cutter Vance, plus recruitable strangers.

In the story layer each named companion is a character with datoms, so the same face appears in video. See Story and video pipeline.
